correctness.rationale: The actual Lobatto IIIC [0/2] stability function is R(z)=(1-z+z^2/2)^(-1). For transient shift, coefficients are q^k sin((k+1)theta)/(A_h sin theta), q=cos theta-sin theta, theta=arctan(1/(1+h)). Absorption probabilities are q^k[cos(k theta)+sin(k theta)]. All signs are nonnegative iff (n-1)theta<=3pi/4; the first k crossing necessarily lies between 3pi/4 and pi, giving a negative entry. Therefore all h>=0 work for n<=4, and for n>=5 precisely h=0 or h>=cot(3pi/[4(n-1)])-1. A bounded exact-rational inverse test corroborated representative matrix coefficients, row sums and signs.
